title: Vote for AI compatible assets with your wallet
author: RillmentGames
selftext:
Many asset creators add 'NoAI' tags to their assets which makes their work incompatible with modern technology and moving forward the need for AI compatible assets will only increase.   
So you should prefer buying unrestricted assets. Ask creators of restrictive assets to drop the anti-AI stance in exchange for your purchase and to be safe with [Kickstarters 'consent' requirement](https://updates.kickstarter.com/introducing-our-new-ai-policy/) (and whoever else may inquire), ask the asset creator to give explicit consent. Doing so also nudges other asset creators to distance themselves from the anti-AI movement.  
   
The consent is public so we all benefit by asking, I already got 6 animators on the Epic Marketplace to agree so these animations are definitely fine for in-game AI use.  
[\[1\]](https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/product/mocap-studio-series-core-motion-pack/questions), [\[2\],](https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/product/motion-matching-female-locomotion-set/questions) [\[3\]](https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/product/a-huge-animation-bundle/questions), [\[4\]](https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/product/female-locomotion-animation-pack/questions), [\[5\]](https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/product/57-dialogue-mocap-animations/questions), [\[6\]](https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/product/dance-emote-animation-pack/questions)

In my experience it is not too difficult if you find assets that dont have the NoAI tag (but they can add it at any time so getting them to agree is important) and  you assure them that this is only for your game, not resale and in any-case Epic's license forbids resale of derivative works, plus its a new sale for them and who doesnt like money ;P

Even now, you can train AI by yourself but the UE Marketplace 'NoAI' restriction is specifically against training.   
A T5Flann model with 100 million parameters gives good enough results in less than a day's worth of training on an old GPU and it will memorize your character's chat script plus generalize to unseen events a bit, I mean 'in-distribution' it will perform quite well. You dont need a huge foundational model (do you really need math skills? translation? memorized wikipedia and everything else crammed into those huge models?). It wont be a Chat GPT but you have more control, wont need an API and can customize it to do more than just text.   
I dont really want to talk about what I am doing, I just want to convey that it is possible to train and use in-game AI even now, so there will be more and more of this sort of stuff in future games.  


So if you want your purchased assets to be compatible with such things down the line, then vote with your wallet and tell the asset creators that you dont want tech restrictions in the license.
